fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Headpond Transient with Penstock Head Loss
source: Gulliver & Arndt (1991) Hydropower Engineering Handbook, McGraw-Hill; Penche (1998) Layman's Guidebook on How to Develop a Small Hydro Site; IEC 60041

unit.name: Generic Low-Head Run-of-River Plant (Kaplan turbine) — Physics-Lumped

H_design.note: Design gross head = forebay level above tailwater (2-20 m typical for RoR); Gulliver & Arndt (1991) Ch.3

eta_peak.note: Peak hydraulic (turbine) efficiency at BEP, Kaplan; Gulliver & Arndt (1991) Ch.5

k_efficiency.note: Parabolic hill-chart drop coefficient for off-BEP flow

q_min.note: Minimum flow ratio (fraction of Q_design) below which turbine is shut

q_max.note: Maximum admissible flow ratio (gate fully open)

friction_factor.note: Darcy-Weisbach friction factor f (steel, fully-rough turbulent); Gulliver & Arndt (1991) Ch.4

minor_loss_K.note: Sum of minor-loss coefficients (entrance, bends, valve, draft tube exit)

z0.note: Initial forebay level above tailwater (= H_design)

z_max.note: Spillway crest / max forebay level (overtops to spill)

spill_coeff.note: Weir discharge coefficient C_w*L_weir for spill = C*(z-z_max)^1.5

rho.note: Water density at ~10C; Gulliver & Arndt (1991) App. A; CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics
